description: This Java source file defines the ComplexData class, a transient object used within the OpenMRS medical record system to encapsulate complex, non-persisted data associated with an observation. It extends Serializable and contains properties such as data, title, mimeType, and length, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: ComplexData
classes.description: A transient object for holding complex observation data, not persisted in the database, supporting various data types including InputStream and byte arrays.
